adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly adds a `raw_html` cook method that returns `raw` from `Post#cook` without passing through `post_analyzer.cook` (which is the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline): `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb). `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb), and `Jobs::PollFeed` builds `content` from feed item content via `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` then imports it (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb). The embed view renders `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). Since `cooked == raw` for `raw_html`, third-party feed HTML can be stored and rendered without sanitization, enabling stored XSS if the feed content is attacker-controlled.
